official_code_status.rule: No source-code identity or official-code behavior claim may be made from this gate.

source_bound_topology_basis: The 2015 FWC method discretizes the finite water-content domain into a fixed finite number of bins.
The 2015 implementation lineage states that falling slugs were represented with a linked-list methodology.
For the published falling-slug velocity relation, top and bottom move with the same bin velocity so slug length is preserved during pure advection.
The primary source does not establish a forcing-independent hard maximum number of simultaneously active falling-slug list objects per bin or per column.
The 2016 explicit-diffusion extension adds per-bin diffusive redistribution but is not credited here with any unproven topology-merging or minimum-slug-thickness rule.

gate_A_bounded_state.purpose: Falsify or support a forcing-independent persistent-state bound before hydraulic accuracy work.

topology_stress_model.merge_rule: Merge only geometrically overlapping intervals. No heuristic merge, minimum thickness or object cap.
topology_stress_model.bottom_rule: Intervals leaving the finite column are removed as physical boundary outflow events.

modeled_payload_contract.falling_slug_payload_definition: two binary64 endpoints plus two 32-bit integer metadata fields in a packed production-oriented payload model; not sizeof() of official C nodes

decision_rule.unrestricted_dynamic_list_primary_multis: PASS only if a finite forcing-independent maximum persistent object count is established. Otherwise reject this representation for primary MultiSWAP production consideration.
decision_rule.reason: A finite column can plateau for fixed velocity and pulse period while the plateau can still diverge as admitted event period tends to zero or hydraulic residence time grows.
decision_rule.bounded_fixed_slot_followup: May remain research-eligible only with conservative fail-closed overflow and separate physical qualification.

gate_B_exact_mass.purpose: Demonstrate the smallest transaction-safe finite-volume ledger without claiming hydraulic fidelity.
gate_B_exact_mass.initial_storage_definition: deterministic positive binary64 per-bin water-depth payload
gate_B_exact_mass.surface_inflow_definition: deterministic positive boundary water-depth increment each accepted step
gate_B_exact_mass.advective_internal_transfer: fixed fractional donor-to-next-bin finite-volume transfer, exactly ledger-neutral internally
gate_B_exact_mass.bottom_outflow_definition: fixed fractional removal from the final bin, recorded as boundary outflow
gate_B_exact_mass.explicit_diffusion_transfer: nearest-neighbor donor-to-receiver finite-volume transfer proportional to the positive storage difference, applied pairwise and exactly ledger-neutral internally

transaction_test.rejection_condition: candidate front-slot overflow in trial metadata
transaction_test.required_committed_state_check: bitwise identical packed binary64 state before and after rejection
transaction_test.required_committed_ledger_check: exactly unchanged before and after rejection

gate_B_exact_mass.decision_rule: PASS only if both variants satisfy the frozen mass tolerance and rejected trials do not alter committed state or ledger.

hard_nonclaims: No groundwater, crop, SWAP integration or MultiSWAP implementation claim.
No official FWC code reproduction claim.
No diffusion-affordability claim from mass conservation alone.
